Subject: MAP draft and next steps (StellarSys)

Hi Samantha — great call this morning. Thanks for walking through the integration questions and priorities. Per our discussion, I’ve attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and summarized the key milestones below so we can align on owners, dependencies, and a target close date.

Quick recap / proposed MAP highlights:
- Target close date: 2026-07-30 (customer exec review + legal signoff)
- Milestone 1 (Discovery signoff): by 2026-06-22 — Owner: StellarSys (Samantha / Tom) — deliverable: finalized list of PII-scope datasets and existing infra diagram
- Milestone 2 (Pilot config & security review): by 2026-07-06 — Owner: Redwood (Marissa + Rishi) — deliverable: pilot environment, network ACLs, SOC2 evidence packet
- Milestone 3 (Pilot validation + quality checks): by 2026-07-20 — Owner: StellarSys — deliverable: evaluation report and pass/fail criteria
- Milestone 4 (Contract & exec approval): target 2026-07-30 — Owner: StellarSys execs + Redwood (pricing & legal)

Dependencies we flagged:
- Exec pricing approval for proposed discount / credits (customer requested 20% off + $50k one-time credit) — will need to route to Redwood pricing committee
- Legal review: StellarSys legal indicated a 7–10 business day turnaround once SOW sent
- Pilot data access: StellarSys to provide sanitized test data and VPN/peering details

Ask: Please confirm the milestones and owners in-line by EOD Wednesday (2026-06-17). If the timing looks tight for legal/execs, flag which items we should move earlier.

Attachment: Stellarsys_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, acceptance criteria)

Thanks — I’ll start an internal pricing escalation thread to get preliminary guidance on the discount request.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A couple notes from my side:

- The target close date of 2026-07-30 works provided we get a timely exec review. Our CFO (Jason Meyers) will need a succinct one-pager showing cost/benefit and the proposed commercials before he signs off.
- On pricing: our procurement asked whether Redwood can stretch to 20% off and a $50k credit for the first year if we commit to a 12-month annual committed spend (~$250k ARR). That’s their starting ask — I know you’ll need to escalate.
- Legal: I’ve attached the SOW requirements document so your legal team can pre-check clauses (we typically require a 6-month data retention option in contracts).

I’ll confirm the internal owners for Milestone 1 by EOD tomorrow. For the exec one-pager, can you provide an initial draft of the commercials you’d propose if pricing committee needs a counter?

Attachment: Stellarsys_SOW_requirements.pdf

Best,

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP draft and next steps (StellarSys) — pricing escalation request

Thanks for the context, Marissa. I reviewed the MAP and the customer ask. Given StellarSys’s strategic fit and healthy potential for expansion, I can provisionally approve an exception with the following commercial guardrails:

- Counter offer: 18% discount on list rates + $40,000 one-time credit for a 18-month committed spend (minimum annual committed ARR $250k)
- If the customer insists on a 12-month term, cap discount at 15% + $25,000 credit.
- Require contractual SLIs for pilot acceptance (performance & latency SLO) and 90-day review with option to convert to Dedicated pricing post-pilot.
- Legal to confirm retention clause language; if retention requirement is >6 months we need explicit risk signoff from security and Legal (copy Pete from Legal).

Action items for Marissa:
1) Finalize MAP with the counter commercial language and updated target close date (still aiming 2026-07-30).
2) Draft a one-page exec summary (commercials + value props + deployment timeline) to share with their CFO. Use the counter above as starting point.
3) Open the deal in HubSpot (I see DEAL-2026-4872 as suggested id) and attach the MAP + SOW requirements.

I’ll loop in legal/ops separately if we need a signed pricing exception. For now, you can share this counter with Samantha as the pricing team’s position. Keep me posted on their response.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
